short: bare p piece that opens a split word
notes: Card: ' P' x9, 'P' x6, 'p' x4, ' п' x4, '-p' x2, 'up'. Tokenizer checked for the test words. Probes: common-pool 0.37-0.52, Proust (with Pushkin) 0.50, Proust alone 0.21, PWD 0.38, Bauprogramm 0.39-0.46; Tolstoy 0.00, Pasternak 0.00, sub-prime 0.01, up-front 0.00, puppy 0.01, Bauarbeiter 0.03. The declared tokens also occur in other uses, so measured coverage is an upper bound; the Cyrillic ' п' case is not tested here.
